case: OK with nothing typed returns every corner exactly, digits the fields do not show included
a typed position moves that one number, through the ruler
one preview for one committed field
a decimal comma is a decimal separator (in this host's parser)
an offset moves from the undistorted corner, in the ruler's direction
text that is not a number changes nothing
the up and down arrows step a field by one unit of the ruler
Cancel returns false, whatever was typed
Enter in a field takes what was typed there and closes with OK
Undistort puts every corner where it is with no distortion
with the preview off, a field still counts; turning it back on previews it
